svg.aria-label: Git declares the gateway, the operator renders it: 1. Install: The OCIRepository pulls the litellm-operator chart. The HelmRelease installs its CRDs and one controller Deployment in ai. 2. Declare: LiteLLMProxy, LiteLLMModel and LiteLLMVirtualKey objects in ai/litellm are the source of truth (file apply mode, store_model_in_db false). Admin UI edits are unverified. 3. Render: The operator writes config.yaml into a ConfigMap and rolls the LiteLLM proxy Deployment when the rendered file changes. 4. Admit: A failurePolicy Fail webhook checks every LiteLLM object at admission. With the operator down, the API server rejects them. 5. Stay quiet: LLMKube auto-registration is off, so the operator never mints a LiteLLMModel that Git did not declare.
